title: STYLE enable ruff PLR5501
body:
Task is:

1. check the [contributing guide](https://<redacted-host>/docs/dev/development/contributing_environment.html) for how to set up your environment
2. remove `PLR5501` from

https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/4d18871d398248c5876035f5aa139292e6a05279/pyproject.toml#L274-L275

3. run `pre-commit run ruff --all-files`
4. fixup the errors it flags
5. stage, commit, push, open pull request

as in, to add
```

"pandas/core/*" = ["PLR5501"]
```
here in this section:

https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/4d18871d398248c5876035f5aa139292e6a05279/pyproject.toml#L288-L290

Then there shouldn't be too many to fixup
